entry.name: extraItems
entry.label: All plasmoid items that are explicitly enabled in the systray. It's a comma-separated string list of plasmoid plugin ids.

entry.name: disabledStatusNotifiers
entry.label: All StatusNotifier items that shouldn't be visible at all. It's a comma-separated string list of StatusNotifier ids.

entry.name: hiddenItems
entry.label: All items that are hidden, forced always in the popup. It's a comma-separated string list of unique identifiers that are either plasmoid plugin ids or StatusNotifier ids.

entry.name: shownItems
entry.label: All items that are shown. It's a comma-separated string list of unique identifiers that are either plasmoid plugin ids or StatusNotifier ids.

entry.name: showAllItems
entry.label: If true, all systray entries will be always in the main area, outside the popup.

entry.name: reverseIconOrder
entry.label: Whether to reverse the order of icons in the panel

entry.name: scaleIconsToFit
entry.label: Whether to automatically scale System Tray icons to fix the available thickness of the panel. If false, tray icons will be capped at the smallMedium size (22px) and become a two-row/column layout when the panel is thick.

entry.name: iconSpacing
entry.label: spacing between icons, determined by this number multiplied by Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing

entry.name: pin
entry.label: Whether the popup should remain open when another window is activated

entry.name: showPinButton
entry.label: Whether the Keep Open pin is shown in popup headers

entry.name: accentColor
entry.label: Accent color used for active controls and sliders

entry.name: controlCenterItems
entry.label: System tray entries promoted to Control Center pills

entry.name: showLogout
entry.label: Show Log Out at the top of Control Center

entry.name: showSwitchUser
entry.label: Show Switch User in the Control Center session menu

entry.name: showRestart
entry.label: Show Restart at the top of Control Center

entry.name: showShutdown
entry.label: Show Shut Down at the top of Control Center

entry.name: compactWidth
entry.label: Manual width of the panel widget in pixels when responsive layout is disabled

entry.name: adaptiveWidth
entry.label: Whether the panel widget follows the live space between neighboring panel widgets

entry.name: showNotifications
entry.label: Whether the notification ticker and launcher are shown in the status area

entry.name: showWeather
entry.label: Whether current weather is shown in the status area

entry.name: temperatureUnit
entry.label: Temperature unit shown in the compact weather readout

entry.name: useOnlineWeatherFallback
entry.label: Whether an online service may supply temperature when the Weather widget does not

entry.name: weatherApplication
entry.label: Desktop entry opened from the weather page header

entry.name: showPriorityBanners
entry.label: Whether important system notifications use the matching banner

entry.name: priorityAlertDuration
entry.label: Seconds important system notifications remain live
